title: Scrumptious No-added-sugar Teabread
steps: Make tea; steep 5 minutes. Put dried fruit in a large bowl; pour in hot tea; stir; leave 5 more minutes.
Add mixed spice, both flours and egg; mix everything together thoroughly.
Line a 900g loaf tin with parchment; spray; spoon batter in and spread evenly.
Bake on bottom shelf for 1 hour. Loaf will look browned on top and be dense but not doughy inside.
notes: Try Earl Grey or Darjeeling for subtle flavour enhancements.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
